name: message-thread
title: Message Thread
description: Threaded replies with the original message and a separate composer.
usage: <MessageThread parent={{ id: "24", author: "Sam", initials: "S", time: "10:00", text: "PR #24" }} />
useCases: In a design review, a designer opens a comment thread and replies with the original message visible above the discussion.
In support, an operator switches between threads. The app keeps each thread’s draft separate from its posted replies.
task: Show a parent message and its replies with a separate composer.
behavior: Pass parent and replies from your app. With a controlled list, append the reply in your data source after onReply succeeds. Use draft and onDraftChange to retain a draft when switching threads.
